messages:
Alex: Starting a simulated-traffic seeding run for rwinf-v2q:int4 canary. Objective: surface slice-specific regressions early. Plan: 0.5% synthetic probes (diverse prompt bank), 2% seeded user traffic, 10% shadow compare. Auto-fallback: >3% quality delta OR >=5% latency tail increase. Kickoff now unless objections.
Maria: 👍 what's the prompt bank size and slices?
Alex: Prompt bank ~2.5k prompts across longform, code, instruction-following, and short-qa. Slices: longdoc, rerank, codegen, short-qa, novelty.
Omar: Can we throttle KV cache warming? int4 warmup might spike cold p99. Propose burst limiter: max 50 qps per model for first 60m.
Maria: Also run a quick NF4->int4 smoke with 1k shadow queries focused on rerank + longdoc to measure hallucination + fidelity deltas.
Alex: Agreed. Smoke plan: run 1k shadow, capture BLEU-like quality proxy, token-level hallucination flag, latency histograms. Using existing eval harness.
Julie: For auto-fallback thresholds I suggest composite rules: immediate rollback if >=4% drop in precision@1 on rerank OR >=8% increase in hallucination rate on any critical slice. Otherwise, soft rollback if drift persists for 12h.
DeployBot: canary-deploy rwinf-v2q:int4 started by Alex. seeds=2% probe=0.5% shadow-sample=1k.
Omar: Observing initial telemetry: coldstart p50 +18%, p99 +55% in first 10m for longdoc slice. Enabling prefix warmup prefetch on affected hosts.
Alex: Pausing seeded traffic at 2367890130 to run 5k synthetic queries focused on rerank slice; will validate metrics then decide to resume to 10%.
Maria: I'll stand up a short-lived dashboard and hook the composite comparator (precision@1, hallucination-rate, p99 latency). If any threshold trips, we auto-open an incident and trigger rollback.
Julie: Reminder: capture qualitative samples (5-10 examples) from each failed slice for triage. Saves a lot of time.
Alex: Thanks — running the 5k now. Will post summary when complete. If no objections, let the canary run for the next 6h with live monitoring.
Maria: No objections. Keeping an eye.
DeployBot: canary health: shadow-compare complete (1k). quality_delta=+0.6%, halluc_rate_delta=+1.2%, p99_latency_delta=+6%. Continuing seeding as configured.
Omar: Noted. We'll keep burst limiter and warmup in place for next 2h.
Julie: If anything trends upward, we'll cut traffic back to 0 and rollback to NF4.
Alex: Good. Thanks team — will update with final report.
